CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 12.5
   D. 25

3. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 33
   D. 27

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

5. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 37
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 20

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

10. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

11. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 2, 4, 6

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 55
   B. 32
   C. 22
   D. 16

15. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
